name: ELC Bookmarks
source: This repo's printed bookmarks + phonics tracker (app.js BOOKMARK_LEVELS / GRAPHEMES)
notes: teaches lists the PRIMARY (first-listed) sound from app.js's GRAPHEMES sounds[] for each grapheme, except ed, oo, igh-group exceptions ea/ow/oo/ough/ch which app.js's own multi-sound entries call for in full (per task spec). Secondary sounds of other multi-sound graphemes in this same level set (e.g. c's /s/, g's /j/, s's /z/, th's voiced /dh/, y's /igh/ and /i/, o's /oo_long/, u's /yoo/ and /oo_short/, ei/ie/ey's extra sounds, ou's other 3 sounds, si's /zh/) are NOT expanded here to stay literal to the task's exception list; they still exist as GPCs in the bank and a fuller sequence (or gpcs.json's own chart view) can surface them.

units.label: Level 6
units.notes: ch is one of app.js's multi-sound graphemes (chop/school/chef) — all 3 sounds included. th's second (voiced, 'this') sound is not expanded here — see file-level notes.

units.label: Level 7
units.notes: wh mapped to phonemes.json's /w/ (not the app.js-notation 'hw') per phonemes.json's explicit note that wh is taught as a /w/ grapheme.

units.label: Level 8
units.notes: ed and oo are app.js multi-sound graphemes — all sounds included. ed.ed stands for the /ĕd/ sound (landed) = phonemes ["e","d"]; it is not a single phoneme id — see NEEDED_GPCS.md.

units.label: Level 9
units.notes: ea and ow are app.js multi-sound graphemes — all sounds included.

units.label: Level 11
units.notes: ie and ei each have 2 more sounds in app.js (pie/parties, veil/forfeit) not expanded here — primary only.

units.label: Level 12
units.notes: ou has 3 more sounds in app.js (shoulder/you/famous) not expanded — primary only. app.js's 'ear' grapheme entry is unusual: its only listed sound is /er/ via the example 'early', not the far more common NEAR-vowel reading (hear/near) that most phonics programs teach for 'ear' — kept as-is for fidelity to app.js; see accuracy caveats.

units.label: Level 13
units.notes: ough is an app.js multi-sound grapheme — all 6 sounds included. ough.uf (rough) and ough.off (cough) are composite ids standing for phoneme pairs ["u","f"] and ["o","f"] — see NEEDED_GPCS.md. ui and ey each have a second/third sound in app.js (nuisance; they/donkey) not expanded — primary only.

units.label: Level 14
units.notes: si's second sound (/zh/ vision) not expanded — primary only.
